content.title: A Literature-calibrated Digital Twin-inspired Framework for Secure and Predictable IoT Smart Homes
content.abstract: Smart homes are expected to be reliable, secure, and predictable at once, yet most existing systems address these goals in isolation.This paper introduces a literature-calibrated, digital-twin-inspired simulation framework that integrates network behaviour, biometric authentication, and failure prediction within one environment.Rather than assuming independent device failures, the framework models failures as a consequence of a slowly varying networkhealth state, allowing a leakage-controlled classifier trained only on pre-execution signals to achieve moderate predictive discrimination.The fra
